spec.narrative: Each panel represents one dimension of the sovereign investment template as documented across all five cases. Read left to right: corporate winners are named and quantified in Panel 1; community promises and their documented gaps occupy Panel 2; regulatory instruments that made the transfers possible fill Panel 3; and residual costs left entirely on the public are logged in Panel 4. Every item derives from official documents, government announcements, or peer-reviewed case studies — nothing is inferred. The consistent pattern is that concentrated corporate benefit is identifiable before the announcement lands, while community promises are calibrated for political communication, not legal enforcement.
spec.why_this_perspective: Executives need a single surface that names who won and who lost in each documented case before any government counterpart deploys the same playbook on them. The evidential level grounds every cell in official documents, dollar amounts, and named firms.
spec.claimed_territory: Concrete documented gains and losses for each named actor — corporations, communities, and states — across all five cases

anchors.label: Microsoft €976 m, vendor lock-in
anchors.quote: Microsoft received €976 million investment facilitation; Greek SME digitalisation programme subsidises Microsoft 365 and Azure — vendor lock-in with public money.

anchors.label: Greece promised 300 jobs; EIA says 12 FTE per centre
anchors.quote: Greece promised 300 jobs over ten years; official Environmental Impact Assessment tells a different story: at most 12 full-time equivalent positions per data centre.

anchors.label: Microsoft data centre energy up to 159% of Spata-Artemis annual use
anchors.quote: Microsoft's largest Greek data centre expected to consume energy equivalent to up to 159% of the Municipality of Spata-Artemis's total annual electricity consumption at maximum capacity.

anchors.label: 100,000 Greek workers trained in Microsoft proprietary tools only
anchors.quote: Microsoft's training programme for 100,000 Greek workers centres on Microsoft's proprietary solutions — risk limiting workers' flexibility, making their skill sets less transferable.

anchors.label: Lockheed Martin and Raytheon named GWEO Enterprise partners
anchors.quote: Lockheed Martin and Raytheon became the named partners of Australia's Guided Weapons and Explosive Ordnance Enterprise.

anchors.label: Lynas USD 258 m from US DoD; Meteoric and ASM USD 1.28 bn loans
anchors.quote: Lynas received USD 258 million from the US Department of Defense; Meteoric and Australian Strategic Minerals received USD 1.28 billion in US government loans.

anchors.label: Hanwha Aerospace wins USD 4.7 bn infantry vehicle contract
anchors.quote: Hanwha Aerospace won a USD 4.7 billion infantry fighting vehicle contract with Australia.

anchors.label: AUKUS VC network: USD 400 bn in private funds enlisted
anchors.quote: the AUKUS Defence Investor Network brought together private VCs worth USD 400 billion in funds from the three partner countries.

anchors.label: ASN acquired by France for €350 m via APE
anchors.quote: France's acquisition of ASN for €350 million through its public holding agency APE.

anchors.label: Calais plant closure threat drove French nationalisation
anchors.quote: The government's urgency in nationalising Alcatel Submarine Networks was driven by alarm about the prospect of the Calais production plant closing down, which would entail layoffs.

anchors.label: SubCom wins SeaMeWe-6 after HMN Tech removed via US sanctions
anchors.quote: The US Export-Import Bank financed SubCom to make it price-competitive after the US government had used threats of sanctions to remove HMN Tech from the SeaMeWe-6 consortium.

anchors.label: Canada BDC rural communities remain underserved after ten years
anchors.quote: a ten-year official review concluded that rural communities remain underserved by the BDC's offerings.

anchors.label: Pension funds and corporations dominate BDC co-investment returns
anchors.quote: pension funds, corporations, and financial institutions as the dominant co-investors who concentrate the financial return.

anchors.label: Greek land rezoned from agricultural to industrial for data centres
anchors.quote: two laws amended in 2020 and 2021 reclassified agricultural land as industrial to accommodate Microsoft's data centres.

anchors.label: No water recycling system; mayor said it would cost Microsoft too much
anchors.quote: The Environmental Impact Assessment contained no provision for a sustainable water recycling system that would benefit local communities, because, as the mayor conceded, it would have significantly increased the cost to Microsoft.

anchors.label: Greenhouse gas emissions projected to rise at least 50% from initial phase
anchors.quote: greenhouse gas emissions projected to increase by at least 50% following the initial operating phase alone.

anchors.label: Australia: no sovereign submarine capability delivered yet
anchors.quote: Submarine delays; no sovereign sub capability yet; benefits concentrated in named contractors.

anchors.label: China built rival PEACE and EMA cables duplicating the SeaMeWe-6 route
anchors.quote: HMN Tech added to Entity List; China built rival PEACE/EMA cables duplicating the route.
